Role Selector (Patient / Doctor / Admin / Demo Switcher)

admin_dashboard_widgets.kpi_cards: Flat cards with top accent color border, trend indicator (green up arrow / red down), clean mono metrics
admin_dashboard_widgets.peak_hour_heatmap: 7x12 matrix grid showing hourly patient load density from 8 AM to 8 PM across days of the week
admin_dashboard_widgets.doctor_performance_table: Dense data table with sortable columns, availability status badge, total consultations, and average rating star rating

image_urls.description: Modern hospital emergency room entrance with sleek clinical aesthetic

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements (buttons, search inputs, dropdown filters, slot buttons, queue actions, role switches, prescription submit, modal triggers) MUST include descriptive kebab-case data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a portfolio-grade demo application with rich interactive state (mocked real-time queue ticker, slot booking modal, AI symptom analyzer, prescription builder).
Ensure all 3 roles (Patient, Doctor, Admin) can be seamlessly switched via a global Role Bar at the top of the app.
Use Recharts for Admin dashboard analytics charts (Appointments line chart, Specialization demand bar chart, Peak-hour heatmap matrix, Doctor KPIs).
Follow clean clinical visual rules: generous padding, soft slate borders, high text contrast, precise teal/emerald highlights.
Make sure every interactive element contains data-testid for end-to-end reliability.
